reviews.text: Pipsqueak is by far the best place for your small doggo!! Sonja and the rest of the team are amazing. We've been taking our puppy there since he had all of his vaccinations and shots and he cannot get enough of it. Every time we go to drop him off it's all he can do from doing a full sprint to their doors! They also do a great bath and groom service that you can tack on that's very useful during a busy week. Highly recommend! Also if you specifically have a cavapoo you will have lots of friends here!!
Bridget was so welcomed and had a great day at Pipsqueaks. She came home happy from hanging out with dogs her own size. She’s ready to become a regular. 😊
They are wonderful with our young puppy. Highly recommend!
Bella's second day at Pipsqueak and she is doing so well. Everyone at Pipsqueak has been so supportive and super helpful!

I had a bad experience whom to appear was the owner or manager in charge. We were shopping the area and noticed this doggy daycare. I wanted to pop in to inquire. First the door was locked and then someone unlocked it. The woman’s  demeanour was very annoyed that I was even there at the door as she stood in the doorway so I could not see past her. The woman looked at me super annoyed and said YES?? I asked oh I just wanted to peak in and inquire and see what you offer here. She said in the most rudest tone that she was busy and to call them later . It wasn’t even the words she said but it was her energy, where I felt was not warm or welcoming at all. I am also VERY happy I had that first interaction with her like this so I do not bring my dog here. I would 100% not feel comfortable doing so. I am an energy worker and feeling someone’s energy in the first interaction is highly important to me. I have a new puppy , and do not feel comfortable just dropping him off anywhere with anyone.

Pipsqueak takes SUCH good care of the dogs - Bean is always so excited to go inside and play with the other little dogs for daycare. I know he is going to have the best day ever when I drop him off - lots of playing and love from the staff and good walks! My favourite part is being able to go on Instagram and see updates throughout the day so I get to see my little guy having a blast! Sonia is also a dog trainer, so I know Bean is in VERY good hands. I'm so happy I found this place. They even gave Bean a complimentary nail trim 🥹

EDIT: A year later and they continue to be the best daycare. They really care about the dogs and take such good care of them. I feel so incredibly relieved to know my pups are being taken care of while I'm in all-day meetings.

I have had nothing but fantastic experiences with Pipsqueak Pups. My pup has severe separation anxiety and Sonja and her team gave me the peace of mind I needed to know that he was safe and happy while I returned to work. He is totally comfortable in their care and comes home ready for a nap! I would recommend Pipsqueak Pups to all little dog parents!
We were traveling and needed a dog day care short notice. Pipsqueak pups was super accommodating. Quick response times and our dog was happy!

Every summer, I stay at a condo in Vancouver, but this time I brought my dog, Q, with me from Tokyo. Since he’s a Toy Poodle, he needs a full grooming once a month, and a neighbor recommended this shop to me. It was a bit of an inconvenience that they didn’t accept credit cards, but I’m very satisfied with the service.
My small pup enjoys her daycare time at Pipsqueak Pups. Is nicely tired out when I pick her up. I really appreciate the flexibility of drop-off/pick-up times.
Luigi has been loving his new daycare! He always comes home happy and tired from playing. I’m so glad I found a place that takes such great care of him!

This place is a dream. Our puppy Maple is beside herself with excitement every time we drop her off. Beyond that, the facility is remarkably clean, the team are great communicators, and they even make their own delicious food and treats in-house. You can tell they genuinely love what they do and run the place with real pride and care. I couldn’t recommend Pipsqueaks more.

We feel incredibly lucky to have found Goose’s puppy daycare. Sonja is truly amazing, and Brian and the whole team are always so warm, caring, and welcoming.

Goose comes home happy and perfectly tired every single day from all the fun. It’s clear that each dog is treated with genuine love and kindness, not just as pets, but as part of their extended family.

We’ve also used their overnight boarding when needed and have always felt completely at ease knowing Goose was in such good hands. The beach walks are an absolute must, and the grooming is wonderful too. Goose genuinely loves it all. Don’t forget to pick up some delicious meatballs, toppers, and ice cream.

If you’re looking for a place where your dog will be cared for with heart, attention, and joy, this is it. We couldn’t recommend them more.

Pipsqueak Pups Daycare is our dog's home away from home! All the pups and people are welcoming, caring, and just FUN! Super grateful for the convenience of grooming appointments on site too. Many, many thanks to Sonja and the team.

Small dogs, big needs - met! Sonja, Brian, and the team of Pipsqueak Pups doggie daycare in Kitsilano are amazing!
Fur babies (under 30 pounds and full of energy!) thrive here, and I know they're in great hands. The added bonus of beachwalks, rain or shine, is a game-changer - the pups are  exhausted (and happy!) after a day of playtime,socializing and fresh air on the beach or in the nearby forest.
Highly recommend for busy pet parents who want the best for their tiny fur friends!
Such an amazing team at Pipsqueaks! My mini dachshund loves visiting and is always in good spirits after a day full of play. So happy to have found this doggy daycare.
My puppy had friends to play with and was a happy boy at pick up!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Pipsqueak Pups is absolutely PAW-some! 🎉 We've been lucky enough to have our Chi 🐕 stay with them for home boarding and get pampered with their amazing grooming services. The dog treats are TO DIE FOR (our pup's seal of approval)! 🙌 Their staff is so caring, friendly, and genuinely passionate about the dogs. 16 years of experience speaks for itself! We feel so confident leaving our pup in their hands. Can't recommend Pipsqueak Pups enough! 🐾❤️

I recently moved across the country and stumbled on Pipsqueak Pups while searching for daycare options relatively close to UBC for my little pup, London. I immediately knew this was the right place for us after receiving an email and text from Sonja welcoming us to schedule London's first visit. She kindly and patiently answered all of my questions, and after dropping London off for her first day she sent along photos and videos to show me how my little floof was settling in! 🥹

Sonja, Brian, and the entire Pipsqueak Pups team *clearly* love what they do, and London literally drags me to the door every time I drop her off so I know she loves going! Thank you for making us feel like family from day one ❤️

Sonja and her team are amazing! My dog felt very safe and welcome at Pipsqueak, and Sonja sent me photos and videos of my dog while she was there to reassure me that everything was going well. Can’t say enough about how kind everyone was and what a good experience we have had.

Sonja and Brian were lovely hosts to my babies and graciously accommodating despite my last minute booking. They shared pictures and videos every day and made sure to reassure me about their well being. I appreciate the multiple walks per day and plenty of socializing with both doggy and human friends! Will definitely book again 💕. …
WE LOVE RAMI! Thanks for the review ♥️🐾♥️ …

We are so happy with this daycare for our 15lb maltipoo (Leo)! We've been bringing him here for over a year, since he was a few months old. The staff are really friendly and great at putting us at ease. They are really good at posting daily photos and videos on Instagram so we can see how much fun our pup is having! It's really convenient that we don't need to book in advance, we can just show up. We actually tried a different daycare/company in kits at one point, but our dog was really upset whenever we'd take him there. However with pipsqueak he doesn't seem anxious at all!

I cannot speak highly enough of the professionalism and care that Sonja and Brian demonstrate everyday at Pipsqueak pups. After trying a few other dog daycares in Vancouver, we knew that this was the best and safest spot to leave our little mini Aussie puppy. Unlike at places, our pup begins to wag her tail as soon as we reach the parking lot and is ready to jump out of the car and go play with her friends! At the end of the day, she is always very tired but relaxed and not over stimulated.
Pipsqueak pups is clean, always well maintained and nicely decorated, and Sonja and Brian are amazing at keeping us posted throughout the day. Keep up the great work! We will continue coming to you for our dog daycare and grooming needs.
Always amazing care for our two pups at Pipsqueaks, both at the daycare and for home boarding when we travel. The team there is great and our dogs are always thrilled when we drop them off.
The best place to bring your dog!

I LOVED this daycare. Very simple drop off and pick ups. Great communication with the staff and manager. My pup Lilo got a welcome post and video. She looked like she had so much fun and came home ready for a nice long nap. We’ll definitely be attending regularly. Thank you Pip Squeak. ❤️
Awesome Doggie Daycare, they treat my dog like family! Sonny is super happy to play with other dogs all day long.

I love Pipsqueak’s! Sonja, Brian, and the rest of the team are amazing. The new groomer is also excellent which is great because I don’t have to take my dog to two different places! Overall, 10/10 recommend.

Pipsqueak Pups is simply amazing! Our puppy, Poppy, loves it there. Sonya and Brian take exceptional care of her, treating every dog with love and attention. Sonya's understanding of each pup and Brian's lively play sessions keep Poppy happy and well-socialized. The facility is clean and safe, and Poppy always returns home content and tired. We couldn't ask for a better daycare, and we highly recommend it to fellow dog owners!
Pipsqueaks is truly an amazing doggy daycare!! It’s filled with so much love and happy puppy’s. I love it .
The staff are wonderful and our puppy loves playing with her canine friends.

My Henry has been going to see Sonja and Brian for almost 6 months. Each morning that we drive into the parking lot he starts wagging his tail and stares at me with anticipation. Then he runs to the door as soon as we are out of the car! Henry and I were with his previous daycare for 7+ years and i was worried that we wouldn’t find another place to be a second home for him. I don’t worry about that anymore!
My dogs loves going to Pipsqueaks!!! Always tired and happy when he gets picked up.

I'm not sure what goes on there but my very sweet and loving dog has never not liked anyone or cowered away from someone as he did from the owner of this place. The only person he has not liked in four years. She seems quite rough with the …

Pipsqueak is the best! Their team looks after our Reggie with both care and attention. We have also boarded our dog with them overnight and she had a blast! My wife and I are so grateful to have found such a treasure so close to home.
Thank you!
